feature_contract.goal: Keep original F11 release toggle, game focus cleanup and Windows Alt/system keys working when ImGui reports a consumed Win32 event, while F11 owns ordinary controls and Korean IME composition in stereo Quest gameplay.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Original WndProc bridge and F11-only input routing; do not change game UI geometry, font atlas, VR eye transforms, FFB, world, SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK or native desktop input.
trace_stages: Game window receives original F11, focus, OS system and IME messages.
ImGui Win32 backend queues eligible input and may return nonzero.
Only UI-owned ordinary input is consumed; F11/focus/system proceed to original game WndProc even when ImGui reports handled.
subcomponents: Original F11 key-up path and release transitions are never dropped by backend return.
Windows focus/Alt/system transitions reach original game procedure after ImGui synchronization.
IME START/COMPOSITION/END remains F11-owned; closed-shell gameplay and normal binding-dialog navigation remain unchanged.
Executable portable native ownership matrix and existing source-bound workflow regression.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: When ImGui reports handled, legacy F11 release, game focus changes and OS Alt/system commands still enter the original game WndProc.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: F11 IME and closed gameplay input protection
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Visible F11 owns Korean IME START/COMPOSITION/END and ordinary UI keys; hidden F11 and desktop gameplay retain their native input.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 x86 game and x64 host integration
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native C++ ownership and negative regression pass along with exact-SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, Full Source and HUD Inspector Gates.

runtime_limit: No same-SHA Quest3/VDXR game session; visual/input acceptance not claimed.

diagnosis.root_cause: Nonzero ImGui_ImplWin32_WndProcHandler return bypassed the original game WndProc even for native F11, focus and Alt/system messages; Korean IME composition begin and end also bypassed F11 input consumption.
source_trace: Original game Win32 procedure receives legacy F11, focus, system and IME messages.
The F11 routing sends eligible input through the ImGui Win32 handler which can return a nonzero handled result.
The original game must still receive F11 releases, native focus and Alt/system transitions, while F11 should capture editing IME lifecycle messages.
alternatives_rejected: No GPU pose or font/raster change is necessary because the defect is in Win32 message control flow rather than R84 rendering or font layout.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Native Win32 message policy preserves F11, focus and system messages regardless of ImGui handled result and captures IME start/end in visible UI, retaining native FFB/gameplay routing.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing C++ F11 shell smoke exercises 8 preservation combinations and input negative cases; source-bound verifier checks native hook, IME events and policy mutations.

validation_notes: All four required GitHub Actions workflows completed SUCCESS on exact SHA 34985c75; no Quest3/VDXR HMD session, so no runtime or visual acceptance.
